pharmacology.text: Buprenorphine-3-glucuronide (B3G) is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine. It has affinity for the μ-opioid receptor (Ki = 4.9 (± 2.7) pM), δ-opioid receptor (Ki = 270 nM), and nociceptin receptor (Ki = 36 μM), but not for the κ-opioid receptor. Whether B3G acts as an agonist or antagonist of each of the former three respective sites has yet to be determined.

uses.en: It is not given as a medicine. It exists in the body after buprenorphine is taken, and is studied to understand how buprenorphine works.
uses.zh: 它不作為藥物使用。它在服用丁基原啡因後存在於體內，被用於研究丁基原啡因的作用機制。
uses.zhHans: 它不作为药物使用。它在服用丁基原啡因后存在于体内，被用于研究丁基原啡因的作用机制。

fact.en: It is what the body makes when it bolts a sugar onto buprenorphine to flush it out. Unusually, this supposedly spent product still binds the mu-opioid receptor extremely tightly.
fact.zh: 它是身體把一個糖分子接到丁基原啡因上以便排出時產生的物質。不尋常的是，這個理應已失效的產物仍與 μ 鴉片受體結合得極為緊密。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体把一个糖分子接到丁基原啡因上以便排出时产生的物质。不寻常的是，这个理应已失效的产物仍与 μ 鸦片受体结合得极为紧密。
